output.summary: D25 (user choice, option 1): a cleanly terminated review whose CLI exits non-zero (API error, safeguard refusal, sign-in; no report, since ContainerReviewer parses a report only after exit 0) is now verdict unknown, and the round stops human_required with reason REVIEW_RUNNER_FAILED instead of fail/fix_required/CHECK_FAILED. No Engineer rebuild, no automatic fix spent, no automatic retry; registered checks with a non-zero exit stay fail; other unknowns keep UNKNOWN_RESULT; kit unchanged (unknown review already routes to action human). Found in the 2026-10-27 app-be real check (claude sonnet reviewer blocked by an API safeguard was counted as a defect and rebuilt). src/core/verification.ts adds reviewRunnerFailed(), used by classify() and by record() for the reason. TDD: tests/verification.test.mjs (observed stream) and tests/coordinator.test.mjs (kit Reviewer runner failure, Developer runs once) failed first (actual 'fail' / 'awaiting_g4'); on main 68be1dc with src reverted 56/58, restored 58/58. tests/budgets.test.mjs fixture made its failed round with a review exit 1; it now fails a registered check instead, keeping the one-fix-per-failed-round rule it tests.

Independent report-only review of the diff (verification.ts, verification/coordinator/budgets tests): Approve, no Critical. Unknown can never reach awaiting_g4 (record() moves there only when every node passes, #subject is null otherwise, requestChanges and delivery require awaiting_g4), so M4 holds. The REVIEW_RUNNER_FAILED reason choice was checked: results are written only through record(), every unknown closes the round, record() checks 'checking' inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and DatabaseSync is synchronous, so concurrent test/review recording cannot interleave. Important 1 (commit the budgets.test.mjs fixture change together) was already in the change. Minor: redundant coordinator assertion removed; verdict==='unknown' simplification declined (kept nodes.some so a broken invariant still stops); check-fail-then-runner-fail stops with REVIEW_RUNNER_FAILED (documented); pre-existing kit finishReview records needs_changes for an unknown review (left as follow-up). Downstream: lean stopOf and native-office show the reason verbatim, nothing special-cases UNKNOWN_RESULT.

Fresh verification 2026-10-27 on main 68be1dc plus this change, after the review fixes (worktree codex/review-runner-error): npm test 927/929, exit 1; the 2 failures (tests/claw-lifecycle.test.mjs:17, tests/lean-lifecycle.test.mjs:172) were both 'Office startup timed out' under load average 24-33 (three other sessions running suites) and pass alone 15/15 (exit 0). The same change before review on codex/lean-office 1e7883e: 929/929. Related files on main: src reverted 56/58 (only the two new tests fail), restored 58/58. npm run typecheck exit 0. Story checker (check.mjs story) exit 0. Changed files: src/core/verification.ts, tests/{verification,coordinator,budgets}.test.mjs, Story D25, docs/STATUS.md, docs/verification/2026-10-27-review-runner-failure.md. Unproven: a live runner failure taking this path (a safeguard refusal cannot be reproduced on demand), codex reviewer API-error exit codes, rerun of a stopped task (follow-up). G4 remains human-owned.
